postal_system.assignment_rule: The UPU Universal DataBase Sep. 2025 list, updated 20 August 2026, includes Burundi among countries which do not require postal codes. The November 2025 UPU Burundi addressing sheet uses BP, commune and province without a postcode and identifies RNP. A province, commune, locality, office, postal-box number, route, AGID value or synthetic BI planning code is not a Burundi postcode.
postal_system.geometry_rule: No current postcode assignments exist to anchor postcode Polygon or MultiPolygon records. National, province, commune, locality, office, route, service-area, Point, buffer, hull, cell and synthetic geometry must remain independently typed and must not be relabelled as postal geometry.
postal_system.address_format_rule: Store recipient, street or place, BP delivery object, commune, province and country as separate fields. Do not insert a fabricated postcode into domestic addresses.
postal_system.postal_object_rule: A BP/P.O. box number is a delivery object, not a postcode or postal area.
postal_system.building_rule: Building display requires separately rights-cleared civic-address identity and an explicit reviewed relation to point or footprint geometry.
postal_system.derived_and_realtime_rule: Models and realtime services may return independently typed address context only under source-specific rights; they must never manufacture a postcode or postal surface.
postal_system.agid_rule: AGID remains an independent spatial index. BI planning cells and search-result IDs are not RNP assignments or postal geometry.
postal_system.licence_rule: Reviewed RNP, Presidency and UPU pages are reference evidence. UPU copyright restrictions do not grant AGID processing, derivation, redistribution or public-serving rights for a postal dataset.
postal_system.jurisdiction_rule: Preserve ISO BI identity and Burundi's territory; do not borrow codes or geometry from another jurisdiction.
postal_system.privacy_rule: Recipients, box holders, customer addresses, parcel observations, coordinates, buildings and query logs remain excluded absent explicit authority and minimisation.
postal_system.temporal_rule: No-postcode status is time-dependent; preserve retrieval time, edition, exact bytes and SHA-256 and re-check after the pending-country sweep or an official announcement.

stages.definition: Burundi address-format inventory, draft country pack, synthetic planning cells and conformance fixtures only.
Digest-bound RNP, Burundi Presidency and UPU evidence that Burundi currently does not require postal codes, plus rights, identity, current address format and no-proxy contracts.

M2 requires a current authoritative RNP or competent public release establishing a Burundi postcode system and a complete finite denominator of every assignment, alias, validity interval, correction, exception and explicit non-area object, fixed with retrieval time, edition, stable identity, schema, coverage, bytes and SHA-256 under rights compatible with AGID processing, storage, derivation, redistribution and public serving. Current UPU evidence says Burundi does not require postcodes; absence is represented as none and does not satisfy the Polygon/MultiPolygon milestone. If a future system is introduced, every drawable code must reconcile to fixed real Polygon/MultiPolygon geometry with postal authority, official/derived/virtual class, source, reference date, CRS, topology, method, confidence and exceptions. Country, province, commune, locality, address, office, route, service area, postal box, building, Point, buffer, hull, Voronoi/raster cell, AGID cell and synthetic BI planning code are prohibited proxies. An approved immutable artifact must drive the real BI API/app, handling no-code/no-match, loading, multiple, failure and invalid geometry states, map fit, translucent fill, clear outline, clear/re-search, and display of code, geometry kind, class, source, date and confidence.

agid_integration.current_scope: BI metadata, no-postcode policy, current BP/commune/province address format and synthetic planning fixtures only; no real BI Postal Context descriptor is enabled.
agid_integration.enablement_gate: A future authoritative postcode release, compatible rights, immutable assignment and geometry artifacts, and actual BI loader/API/app verification are required.
agid_integration.geometry_rule: Do not manufacture a Burundi postal polygon. Independently licensed context remains typed and source-qualified.
